authority.scope: GTK2 scrollbar comparison; isolated test only, no installed theme changes.

question: Does GtkScrollbar::trough-under-steppers change the apparent GTK2 stepper rendering when the same installed wrapper and dynamic palette are loaded?

method.runtime: GTK 2.24.33; native GtkHScrollbar and GtkVScrollbar in private authenticated Xvfb :188.
method.baseline: Installed GTK2 wrapper and generated palette include, as captured in R326.
method.candidate: The first temporary RC added a GtkScrollbar class style. R328 repeated the property inside the existing generated palette style and produced a byte-identical candidate capture, confirming the same visible result with the existing pixmap assets and geometry.
method.warnings: No GTK RC parser or asset-load warnings.

observed.render: The candidate differs from baseline in actual GTK2 drawing. R328 reproduces the identical candidate image after changing only GtkRange::trough-under-steppers within the existing generated palette style.
observed.historical_match: R328's coordinate-registered direct comparison shows the candidate has more pixel differences than the installed rendering for both horizontal arrow cells; even the best local 15x15 registration remains worse. Do not apply this property as the correction.

conclusion: The first RC route is visually equivalent to a same-style one-property edit, as verified by byte-identical R328 output. Exact horizontal-cell comparison rejects trough-under-steppers=false as a fix for the current discrepancy. The installed theme remains unchanged.
